text:
incident-bot: Alert: elevated 504/timeouts observed for hosted inference POST /v1/generate in ap-southeast-1. Spike start 2025-03-04T18:15:00Z. alert_id=A-9001

support-bot: Incoming customer reports: multiple tenants (including beta-corp and fintech-pulse) hitting p99 timeouts and streaming failures. User-facing error rate ~22% over 12m.

maya: Support confirmed error samples: most show 504 gateway timeouts; a subset shows 502 with upstream auth proxy errors '401->502 token fetch fail'. Customer impact flagged HIGH.

raj: Observed at the gateway: auth-proxy calls to billing-service (sync) are timing out under load, and billing-service is returning 503s due to KMS throttling on signer requests. The request path does an inline billing entitlement check that calls KMS.

kyle: Runtime traces from backend: inference nodes are healthy but requests stall waiting on auth/billing call response; after ~60s the gateway returns 504. No obvious KV cache warmup here.

sophie: Repro attempt from ap-southeast-1: curl shows 504 at ~58s and gateway logs show "auth-check timeout". Repro snippet: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"summarize...","max_tokens":256}'
# -> 504 after ~58s
```

ops-bot: Recent deploy: billing-service v2.4.1 rolled out to ap-southeast last night; it switched to synchronous KMS signing per-request (was async batch previously). Rollback candidate marked.

maya: Customers asking for immediate mitigation. Two asks: stop 5xx for customers, and give ETA.

raj: Short-term mitigation options (pick one):
- A) Route affected tenants to a bypass route that skips inline billing entitlement check (requires ops override and audit)
- B) Promote a regional canary rollback of billing-service to v2.4.0
- C) Increase KMS client concurrency/quota (throttle change) (contact cloud infra)

kyle: Quick safest: B) rollback billing-service in region. Ops command below (ops only):

```
# rollback billing service to v2.4.0 in ap-southeast-1
kubectl -n services rollout undo deployment/billing-service --to-revision=20250303-2400 --context ap-southeast-1
# verify pods ready
kubectl -n services get pods -l app=billing-service --context ap-southeast-1
```

ops-bot: Can do rollout undo, but rolling back is disruptive for a few seconds of pod restarts. A is faster but requires an emergency policy waiver.

sophie: Support prefer A if it is quick and auditable. We can apply a per-tenant routing override to skip billing check for identified tenants (beta-corp, fintech-pulse) while we rollback region-wide or fix KMS quotas.

raj: Ops command for routing override (ops only):

```
# route override to skip billing-check (audit tag required)
redwoodctl routes update --path /v1/generate --region ap-southeast-1 \
  --override-skip-billing-check beta-corp,fintech-pulse --audit-tag bypass-20250304
```

maya: Please provide exact steps so support can confirm once applied. Customers want a status update in 15m.

(5m later)

ops-bot: Applied routing override to skip billing-check for identified tenants at 10% -> monitoring. Audit tag recorded bypass-20250304.

support-bot: Canary metrics: 10% traffic on override -> error rate on canary tenants reduced from 24% to 2%. p95 latency down ~50% for those shards.

kyle: Given canary result, promote to 100% for those tenants while rollback/fix proceeds.

ops-bot: Promoted override to 100% for listed tenants. Monitoring live.

(20m later)

support-bot: 20m after promotion: affected tenants show normal error baseline; global error-rate decreased. No new 504 bursts for those customers.

maya: Sent customer comms: temporary bypass applied for affected tenants, we are investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline. Customers acknowledged; requested ETA for permanent fix.

raj: Root cause hypothesis: billing-service v2.4.1 made per-request KMS signer calls synchronously which, combined with a KMS quota misconfiguration for ap-southeast region, caused throttling. The synchronous call is on the request path so it amplifies backend latency into 504s.

sophie: Immediate action items (short-term):
- keep overrides in place for affected tenants until rollback or KMS quota increase (owner: ops, ETA immediate)
- rollback billing-service v2.4.1 in ap-southeast (owner: ops, ETA 1h)
- open cloud support ticket to raise KMS quota and review signer client backoffs (owner: raj, ETA 2h)

raj: Medium-term (24-72h):
- revert sync signing into async background path for billing-service (RFC + PR, owner: raj, ETA 48h)
- add circuit-breaker around billing-check with cached short-lived entitlements to avoid blocking the request path (owner: kyle, ETA 72h)
- add alerting for regional KMS throttling signals (owner: ops, ETA 48h)

maya: Customer comms: support to provide ETA after ops confirms rollback or KMS quota change. I'll post an update in 30m.

incident-bot: Created ticket INC-2025-9001 and linked this thread.

ops-bot: Rollback to v2.4.0 complete in ap-southeast; smoke tests passed. Observability: billing-service call latencies back to normal.

support-bot: 90m after mitigation: affected tenants stable, global 504 rate returned to baseline. War room de-escalating; leaving thread open for postmortem.

maya: Postmortem scope: billing-service synchronous KMS calls + regional KMS quota misconfig -> customer-impacting 504s. Retro scheduled 2025-03-05 10:00 UTC. Please add notes and attach logs to INC-2025-9001.

kyle: I'll upload the minimal repro script, gateway traces, and billing-service deploy timeline to the ticket.

raj: I'll draft the RFC for async signer and circuit-breaker; will include rollout plan and smoke tests.

sophie: Thanks team. If anything regresses, ping @oncall and reopen. :thumbsup:
